result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use area with sidewalks present but lacking marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals. Pedestrians face long crossing distances and potential conflicts with turning vehicles without designated crossing paths or signal protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the path of the narrow sidewalk on the left side of the image, restricting clear passage.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a very wide but poorly maintained paved area in the foreground that is being used for vehicle parking, creating conflicts. While sidewalks exist on both sides of the street, the lack of marked crossings and the degraded pavement surface significantly reduce pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The large paved area in the foreground is heavily cracked and uneven, posing a significant trip hazard.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked on the wide paved area intended for pedestrians, obstructing the path and creating conflict points.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the wide pedestrian area to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install physical barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark the intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, but the pedestrian environment is compromised by a lack of marked crossings and physical buffers from traffic. The left side of the roadway has a wide paved apron used for informal vehicle parking, which creates potential conflict points and obscures the intended pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Vehicle encroachment
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side occupy a wide paved area that lacks clear delineation between pedestrian and vehicle space.

hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated protection or visibility aids.
